title: The Sweet Spot
description: Enjoy all Nashville has to offer in this awesome location in the heart of Nashville, located between the Gulch and 12 South and next to Belmont University.  With all new furnishings and home goods, it’s stylishly decorated and appointed to make your trip a great experience.  There are two bedrooms on the first floor and one loft bedroom on the second floor, enjoy the fully equipped kitchen, outdoor bbq, sitting area and dining table.  Come stay at the Sweet Spot, located close to everything!
